def transform(g):

    hs={i for i,r in enumerate(g) if len(set(r))==1}
    vs={j for j in range(W) if len({r[j] for r in g})==1}
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    sep={v for v,c in cnt.items() if c==len(hs)*W+ (H-2*len(hs))*0 } # placeholder
    # background = most common non-separator color; separator colors = colors of the full lines
    sepcols={g[i][0] for i in hs}|{g[0][j] for j in vs}
    body=[v for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if i not in hs and j not in vs]
    bg=Counter(body).most_common(1)[0][0]
    import itertools
    def groups(idxs):
        return [[v for _,v in grp] for k,grp in itertools.groupby(enumerate(idxs),lambda x:x[1]-x[0])]
    R=groups([i for i in range(H) if i not in hs]); C=groups([j for j in range(W) if j not in vs])
    anomaly=[v for v in cnt if v not in sepcols and v!=bg]

        for c in C:
